title: Integrate wolfKM FIPS status into shim public API
description: wolfKM exposes FIPS aggregate state via CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_STATUS ioctl (returns struct crypto2dev_status.fips_state). The shim has no way to surface this. Add wc_crypto2dev_fips_status() public function, update selftest to check FIPS state before AES-GCM oracle, and replace WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV_REQUIRE_FIPS probe-fd with STATUS query.
